frozen_plan.test_policy: previously exposed; excluded from feature construction, fitting, audits, prediction and scoring
frozen_plan.source_access: shared archive decoded for original eligible-row indexing; only frozen development rows materialized
frozen_plan.imputation_policy: SEXFL != 0 -> sex unknown; AGEFL not in [0,1] or BDATEFL != 0 -> age unknown; flags not predictors
frozen_plan.preprocessing: same explicit-state/one-hot algorithms as experiment1, fit on leakage-masked training rows only
frozen_plan.sample_weight: n_train / (5 * training_class_count); no oversampling or survey weights
frozen_plan.selection: eligible only if macro-F1 improves over both original and masked frozen-logistic references, each severe-class recall is no worse than either reference and each severe underclassification count is no larger than either reference; select maximum validation macro-F1 then leaf5 on exact tie; otherwise reject both and retain the highest-macro-F1 diagnostic candidate without promotion
frozen_plan.abstention: fixed descriptive threshold; not selected or fitted on validation
